# QTR Filing Package — NovaPay Ltd. — Q3 2024
**Status: DRAFT — pending approval & attestation**

---

## PART 1 — Filing Header & Metadata

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Entity | NovaPay Ltd. |
| Regulator | Aurelia Financial Conduct Authority (AFCA) |
| Rule | 2024-07, Section 3.2 |
| Report | Quarterly Transaction Report (QTR) |
| Reporting period | 2024-07-01 to 2024-09-30 (Q3 2024) |
| Filing deadline | **2024-10-21** (15 business days after quarter end) |
| Exemption test | Volume 45,230 ≥ 10,000 → **Full QTR required** (simplified QTR not available) |
| Filing type | **Full QTR** |

## PART 2 — QTR Data Payload (§3.2 mandated contents)

**(a) Count metrics**

| Report Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Total transaction volume | 45,230 |
| Number of transactions | 45,230 |

**(b) Aggregate value by currency**

| Currency | Aggregate Value |
|---|---|
| USD | 12,450,300.00 |
| EUR | 3,210,450.75 |
| GBP | 980,200.10 |

**Completeness check:** all three §3.2-mandated elements present → **YES** (2 count fields + 3 currency rows).

## PART 3 — Data Quality Exceptions (from assembly checks)

| # | Observation | Severity | Effect on filing |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `total transaction volume` = `number of transactions` (45,230 both) | **High** | The two distinct dictionary fields return identical values → either genuine, or the count-logic distinction (from the prior lineage step) is unresolved. **Must be explained before attestation.** |
| 2 | Neither count field carries a currency dimension | Info | Compliant — §3.2 requires counts unsegmented. |
| 3 | No FX rate source/date documented for currency aggregation | High | Valuation/FX remains uncontrolled; values are **as-submitted, unverified**. |
| 4 | Sum of currencies ≠ any single "total value" requirement | Info | §3.2 requires value *by currency* only — no grand total mandated. |

---

## PART 4 — Approval & Attestation Step

**Approve / attest via the checklist below. Signature blocks are placeholders pending named signatories.**

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  A. PREPARER — confirms data extracted from core_txn_log, Q3 window  │
│     and reconciles to source totals.                                  │
│                                                                       │
│     Prepared by (name/role): ______________________  Date: __________ │
│                                                                       │
│  B. REVIEWER — independent check that:                                │
│     [ ] Deadline 2024-10-21 confirmed                                 │
│     [ ] Full (not simplified) QTR correctly applied (vol ≥ 10,000)    │
│     [ ] Exception #1 (volume = count) explained/cleared               │
│     [ ] All 3 currencies reported with rates sourced                  │
│                                                                       │
│     Reviewed by (name/role): ______________________  Date: __________ │
│                                                                       │
│  C. ATTESTATION — authorized signatory certifies accuracy/completeness│
│                                                                       │
│     "I attest the QTR for Q3 2024 is complete and accurate per        │
│      AFCA Rule 2024-07 §3.2."                                         │
│                                                                       │
│     Attested by (Director/MLRO): __________________ Date: __________  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## PART 5 — Filing Package Contents & Sign-off State

| Item | Component | Owner | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | QTR data payload (Parts 2a/2b) | Data/Reporting | ✅ Prepared |
| 2 | Deadline & exemption computation | Compliance | ✅ Confirmed |
| 3 | Data-quality exception log (Part 3) | Controls | ⚠️ Open items #1, #3 |
| 4 | Preparer sign-off | Reporting analyst | ⬜ Pending |
| 5 | Independent reviewer sign-off | Compliance | ⬜ Pending |
| 6 | Attestation | Authorized signatory | ⬜ Pending |

---

## Bottom Line
The Q3 2024 QTR draft is **assembled and complete against §3.2's three mandated elements** (volume, count, value by currency), and the volume test correctly mandates a **Full QTR (deadline 2024-10-21)**. **However, the package is NOT ready to file** because:

1. **Exception #1 is unresolved** — `total transaction volume` and `number of transactions` are identical (45,230), which the earlier lineage analysis flagged as a definitional ambiguity. An attestation of two distinct mandated fields returning the same number requires explicit justification.
2. **Exception #3 is unresolved** — no FX rate source is documented, so the currency values are unverified.

Complete sign-offs in Parts 4–5 only after exceptions #1 and #3 are resolved. Provide the reconciliation detail (or confirm the count distinction) and I'll re-run and close out the attestation checks.
